gloss: the real culprit; the true criminal

definitions.gloss: the real culprit; the true perpetrator
definitions.explanation: The person who actually committed a crime, as opposed to someone wrongly suspected or falsely accused.

examples.japanese: {真犯人|しんはんにん}はまだ{捕|つか}まっていない。
examples.english: The real culprit has not yet been caught.

examples.japanese: {新|あら}たな{証拠|しょうこ}が{真犯人|しんはんにん}を{指|さ}し{示|しめ}した。
examples.english: New evidence pointed to the true criminal.

examples.japanese: {無実|むじつ}の{人|ひと}が{疑|うたが}われている{間|あいだ}に、{真犯人|しんはんにん}は{逃|に}げてしまった。
examples.english: While an innocent person was under suspicion, the real culprit got away.

notes:
Compound of the prefix {真|しん} (true, real) + {犯人|はんにん} (criminal, culprit). The {真|しん} contrasts the actual offender with a suspect or scapegoat, so the word is common in mysteries and crime reporting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真犯人|しんはんにん}を{捕|つか}まえる: to catch the real culprit
- {真犯人|しんはんにん}が{判明|はんめい}する: the true criminal comes to light
- {真犯人|しんはんにん}は{別|べつ}にいる: the real culprit is someone else

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {容疑者|ようぎしゃ}: suspect — someone suspected, not yet proven guilty
- {犯人|はんにん}: culprit; offender — the general word, without the "as opposed to a suspect" nuance
